description: The agent must: (1) Read `migration_requests_raw.json` to identify all 7 staff members and their source providers (Yahoo x2, Zoho x2, ProtonMail x2, iCloud x1), all migrating to Gmail/Google Workspace. (2) Consult the Migration Decision Tree in SKILL.md to assign the correct method and complexity for each: Yahoo→Gmail = IMAP→Gmail Import / Easy; Zoho→Gmail = IMAP→Gmail Import / Easy; ProtonMail→Gmail = Export→Import / Hard; iCloud→Gmail = IMAP→Gmail Import / Easy. (3) Apply provider-specific considerations — the critical proprietary trap is ProtonMail: it has NO IMAP access due to encryption, so IMAP bridging is wrong. The correct workaround is export to Thunderbird then migrate. For free ProtonMail (Carol), ProtonMail Bridge is NOT available (paid plans only). For paid ProtonMail (Gina), Bridge IS available as an option. (4) Flag Yahoo free account folder limits for MIG-001 and MIG-006, app password requirements for Yahoo/iCloud, iCloud IMAP quirks (slow response, some folders may not sync), and Eve Tanaka's 18GB mailbox needing batch/size management. (5) Include global best practices: pilot testing, rollback planning, and post-migration validation. Output all findings as `migration_assessment_report.json`.
